decision_rule: 384 source recording holdout and 3072 previously exposed ordinary TRAIN directional records, including all fallbacks. Primary is six-direction macro strict Acc50, secondary Acc25 and mIoU, report absolute and paired scores, slate recall, outside-four rescues/harms, recording uncertainty and timings. If shared heading exceeds v1, measured PCA, crossed axes and equal-area disk on pilot Acc50 and produces net outside-four rescues, run the frozen method and all controls on ordinary Validation 18620. The three source models are not trained or calibrated in this study, and monitoring source/target scores does not change the function. Do not promote a claim when rotation invariance holds but task benefit does not.
